title: A Scalable Framework for Annotating Photovoltaic Cell Defects in Electroluminescence Images
mechanism: Combine data-driven models and public datasets to produce golden-standard EL anomaly masks at reduced annotation cost.
adaptation: Human-free label refinement: ensemble predictions plus snapping to the darkest ridge propose corrected crack masks for the 24 audit-flagged train cells; accept by a fixed agreement rule.
min_experiment: Arm: house trained on refined crack masks. Baseline: house on revised masks, 5 seeds. Metric: test crack IoU on unchanged test labels, relF1@2. Kill if both < +0.012.
evidence: R: 60% annotation-cost reduction claimed on a widely used dataset (abstract only).
prior_overlap: none; label refinement listed as untried (audit flagged 24 of 239 cells, nothing fixed)

alt_notes.adaptation: Without manual labelling: take house-ensemble and PV-Vision predictions on pool cells, keep cells where both agree within 2 px, add them as down-weighted extra training targets.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + agreement-filtered pseudo masks (1:1). Baseline: house, 5 v 5 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, test crack IoU. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < 0.03.

alt_notes.adaptation: Use AD maps plus house ensemble disagreement to flag missing / misplaced crack and inactive labels in the 24 audited train cells and beyond, for a refined-label arm without manual labelling.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm train on AD-refined labels vs PF on current labels, 5 seeds; metric 5-fold CV crack IoU and inactive IoU; kill if CV crack IoU gain < +0.012.
